findings.summary: validate="many_to_one" raises MergeError if customers has duplicate customer_id values, so customers must be deduplicated or the error caught.
If region is a categorical dtype, fillna("unknown") raises TypeError because "unknown" is not an existing category.
count skips null order_id values, so the orders count undercounts those rows while their revenue is still summed; size may be needed.
The file has no tests; the "unknown" region case, an empty orders frame, and a customer with null region should be covered.
